== Summary ==
Black-bordered errata card for [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Decipher Errata 1998)]], made by swccg.com on 27 November 2026 from Decipher's white-bordered Premiere Unlimited card [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Unlimited)]] (April 1996). The Unlimited card's game text is word for word Decipher's errata for this card (checked by eye against the Glossary entry), so its black-bordered form is the playable card with Decipher's words (Bill's ruling of 22 November 2026, swccg-guild/work #1297, spec v10).

How it was made: the method of [https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/main/shared/swccg-wiki/evidence/pc-errata-versions/handoff-1297/tools/revised_to_black.py revised_to_black.py], limited to the border band because this card's silver frame is as light as the border (as was done for Tiree): the outer 14 pixels and the light pixels next to them were turned black, scanning in from each edge and stopping at the frame; the corners outside the rounded outline were made grey. Nothing else was changed: the frame, the picture, the text and the legal line are as printed.

Source scan: [[:File:Premiere-U-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarml.jpg]] (490×350). This file: SHA-1 <code>71656f72ed3666ccf2ceb31484bf9a872e7da852</code>.

Maker's mark: swccg.com 2026 (recorded on the page as <code>play_image_mark</code>; no mark is drawn on the image).

Fair use rationale: an image of a copyrighted Decipher card (© Decipher Inc. and Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to show the errata'd card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
